fields.title: Bulgarian foreclosure sale record
fields.description: Every record carries _input, _source, _scrapedAt and recordType. recordType is AUCTION for a sale, SURFACE for a reference probe and ERROR for a failure. Bulgarian field labels are mapped to English names, dates to ISO and prices to numbers in both published currencies - the portal's own labels and values always ship under 'fields'.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The sale ID or list page that produced this record.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

propertyId.title: Sale ID
propertyId.description: The portal's identifier for the sale. IDs are sequential.

locality.title: Locality
locality.description: Town or village where the property is, as published.

districtCourt.title: District court
districtCourt.description: District court the enforcement case belongs to.

enforcementAgent.title: Enforcement agent
enforcementAgent.description: The private enforcement agent running the sale.

agentAddress.title: Agent address
agentAddress.description: Office address of the enforcement agent.

agentEmail.title: Agent email
agentEmail.description: Contact email as published. The portal obfuscates it against harvesters, so it can arrive as a placeholder.

propertyType.title: Property type
propertyType.description: Category as published, e.g. plot with house, apartment, industrial building.

constructionType.title: Construction type
constructionType.description: Construction type where the sale publishes one.

areaUnit.title: Area unit
areaUnit.description: Unit the area is published in - square metres or decares.

startingPriceEur.title: Starting price (EUR)
startingPriceEur.description: Opening price in euro, as published.

startingPriceBgn.title: Starting price (BGN)
startingPriceBgn.description: Opening price in leva, as published. Both currencies are printed on the sale; neither is converted here.

startingPriceRaw.title: Starting price (as published)
startingPriceRaw.description: The price line exactly as printed.

biddingStart.title: Bidding opens
biddingStart.description: First day bids are accepted, YYYY-MM-DD.

biddingEnd.title: Bidding closes
biddingEnd.description: Last day bids are accepted, YYYY-MM-DD.

biddingPeriodRaw.title: Bidding period (as published)
biddingPeriodRaw.description: The period exactly as printed by the portal.

announcementAt.title: Result announcement
announcementAt.description: When the result is announced, ISO date and time.

announcementRaw.title: Result announcement (as published)
announcementRaw.description: The announcement date and time exactly as printed.

publishedAt.title: Published at
publishedAt.description: When the sale was published on the portal. Printed in Bulgarian words on the page and converted here.

description.title: Description
description.description: The legal description of the property as published.

scannedAnnouncement.title: Scanned announcement
scannedAnnouncement.description: Name of the scanned official announcement document attached to the sale.

listPage.title: List page
listPage.description: Which page of the active list this sale came from.

totalPages.title: Total pages
totalPages.description: How many pages the active list had at that page size.

detailFetched.title: Detail fetched
detailFetched.description: True when the record came from the sale's own page rather than only its list card.

fields.title: Published fields
fields.description: Every label/value pair the portal printed, under its own Bulgarian labels - including any this Actor does not map yet.

isAvailable.title: Available (reference mode)
isAvailable.description: Whether the portal answered with usable data.

sample.title: Sample (reference mode)
sample.description: Counts measured during the probe: cards per page, total pages, estimated active sales, newest sale ID.

_detailError.title: Detail error
_detailError.description: Set when the list row was kept because its detail page could not be fetched.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns for scanning the sale list.

deals.title: Deal screen
deals.description: Everything needed to rank sales by price and deadline.

agents.title: Enforcement agents
agents.description: Who is running each sale, with contact details.
